description: Repository module for public Styio example programs and minimal learning samples.

ci_gate_contract.submit_readiness: A styio-example version is submittable when `test / smoke` and `test / golden-standard` both pass.

industry_references: LLVM Testing Infrastructure Guide: small regression cases and reference output comparison
OpenSSF Scorecard: CI tests before merge

resource_classes.description: Owns public example documentation and beginner-facing Styio sample files.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Examples must be self-contained public samples and must not copy production data, private endpoints, or proprietary snippets.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Example changes should track the compiler syntax supported by current public branches.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: An empty or missing README makes the example catalog unauditable.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Generated example outputs and local scratch files must not be tracked.

transitions.on: run sample syntax or documentation check

invalid_operations: ship examples incompatible with current syntax

required_tests: example syntax smoke tests when sample files are present
